R3-1 Button — Figma parity check

Renders all 432 "All Buttons" variants (6 Types × 6 States × 12 Sizes, Figma set 887:2492) and compares computed styles with values transcribed from docs/figma-audit/components/button.md and docs/figma-audit/r3-0-evidence.md (§1–§4, §21). Expected colours are literal Figma hex values (not CSS variables), so the check is independent of the CSS. Serve the project root over HTTP and open this page.
